correctness.rationale: The signature classification is exhaustive after switching. For any dual Gram matrix \(H\), duality implies \(GHG=G\) and \(\operatorname{rank}H\le3\). All symmetric generalized inverses are \(K+za^{\mathsf T}+az^{\mathsf T}\). The one-angle condition reduces to thirty-two exact sign systems over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt5)\); twenty are inconsistent and each of the twelve consistent systems has nonzero determinant. The exact checker independently replays these algebraic steps. The canonical-dual angle and norm sets are read from the verified pseudoinverse.

value.rationale: The primary source explicitly motivates the existence of equiangular duals for non-tight equiangular frames. The \((4,3)\) mixed switching class is the smallest non-tight real equiangular case by number of vectors, so excluding every one-angle dual there gives a natural structural boundary result. It is stronger than a routine canonical-dual calculation because it quantifies over the full affine family of dual frames.
